rationale.angle_support: abs(normal dot camera-forward) >= cos(80deg); at least 10deg away from exact grazing, used only for correspondence eligibility, not RGB quality.
rationale.boundary_support: one-pixel Chebyshev safety band removes source silhouette ambiguity without globally eroding art at runtime.
rationale.atlas_capacity: tile stride is 12 texels; floor(2048/12)=170 tiles per axis, hence 28,900 unique face tiles under the 2K product texture cap.
rationale.totality: definedness is exact and non-negotiable; every supported renderable sample must carry appearance.
rationale.holdout_and_seam: Every source direction must independently carry enough silhouette-adjacent holdout evidence and independently satisfy seam/color/gradient bounds; aggregate statistics may not hide a bad view. Thresholds remain subject-free and are being recalibrated for art quality before Knight.
rationale.rest_art: full source-foreground RGBA and source-alpha coverage are first-class product gates, independent of geometry qualification.
rationale.dynamic_exposure: Compiled-unobserved appearance is bounded globally, per frame and by largest connected visible patch; COMPILED_GLOBAL visibility is forbidden. These budgets are preregistered in the subject-free visual-fidelity recalibration and may not be relaxed from Knight.
rationale.dynamic_appearance_conditioning: Every consequential dynamically visible face is checked in the intrinsic textured-surface metric. The affine UV-to-posed-3D map and generalized rest-to-posed / previous-to-posed surface metrics bound texture and line-art stretch/shear while remaining invariant to rigid 3D rotation and translation. Screen projection conditioning is diagnostic only so legitimate foreshortening is not misclassified as art deformation. Thresholds are subject-free and may not be tuned from Knight.
rationale.dynamic_appearance_conditioning_calibrat: Thresholds are selected by canonical/DYNAMIC_APPEARANCE_CONDITIONING_CALIBRATION_V1_20260921.json from a subject-free synthetic benign/adversarial deformation bank. They are frozen before Knight and may not be relaxed from witness outcome.
rationale.micro_face_visibility: Visible face fragments below the conditioning pixel floor are not silently exempt: their screen-pixel mass is independently bounded, and any consequential face that still cannot support intrinsic conditioning is a hard failure.
rationale.visibility_ambiguity: Exact coplanar overlap between distinct faces is forbidden while V2 exact-depth ties are resolved only by sealed face index. Near-depth ambiguity remains an open subject-free calibration item and may not be guessed from Knight.
rationale.visibility_layers: Geometry contributes up to four exact depth-sorted layers per pixel. Appearance alpha never chooses the geometric ordering; all supported layers are composited front-to-back in linear premultiplied light. Any fifth-layer overflow is a hard product failure.
rationale.surface_sidedness: Until separately qualified backside appearance exists, a consequential face may not reverse projected orientation relative to its rest orientation in the same output camera. Dynamic orientation flips are a hard failure rather than silently rendering inside-out art.
rationale.color_space: Transport RGBA8 is encoded sRGB straight alpha. Source sampling, runtime filtering and multi-layer composition occur in linear-light premultiplied RGBA, then convert back to sRGB only at the output boundary.
